title: Timeouts and 5xx on api-gateway
description: Elevated latency on api-gateway (p95 825ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: Event listeners registered per request in payment-api v2.28.0 were never removed.
expected_symptoms: payment-api memory_usage climbs gradually from ~57% to ~98% over ~39+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on payment-api
payment-api p95 latency rises from ~181ms to ~2.2s as memory grows
payment-api errors appear late, error rate up to ~5.0%
payment-api db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
1 OOM kill / restart event(s) with memory drop and error spike
deployment of payment-api v2.28.0 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back payment-api to v2.27.0 and fixed listener deregistration.
